WHO WE ARE

Engineering Better
Water Environments

Deep Blue Aquatic Systems is a South African aquatic engineering and water technology company specialising in the design, manufacture, supply and installation of systems where water quality, reliability and control matter.

Our experience extends across freshwater and marine aquaculture, farm water treatment, live seafood holding, hatcheries, recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), research facilities, commercial aquariums, water reticulation, natural swimming pools and large specialist pool installations. Operating from Strand in the Western Cape, we undertake both South African and international work.
